title: Early move
description: Whether a sharp move is likely to fade. A big move into absorbing liquidity tends to come back; one into thin liquidity tends to run.

state.label: Move state
state.description: Fade when a big move met absorption, run when it met thin liquidity, and none when nothing sharp has happened. Fade is the contrarian read.

big_move_bps.label: Move size
big_move_bps.description: The size of the latest one-second move that tripped the signal, in basis points. Zero when nothing has tripped.

direction_10s.label: Move direction 10s
direction_10s.description: Which way the price has gone over the last ten seconds. Read it with the state to know which way a fade would go.
